summary: Scaleway Generative APIs (serverless, Europe-hosted, OpenAI-compatible) include a free tier of the first 1,000,000 tokens plus 60 minutes of audio transcription. Usage is billed from token 1,000,001. A credit card and KYC are required to get official rate limits (tokens per minute and queries per minute). Distinct from the separate €100 Business-account credit on the signup page.
claim_steps: Create a Scaleway account and sign up for Generative APIs.
Use the first 1,000,000 tokens and 60 minutes of audio transcription free.
Add a credit card and complete KYC to get official rate limits.

social_proof.title: Model-as-a-service Solutions Pricing | Scaleway
social_proof.text: Try out new models with our free tier : 1 million tokens and 60 minutes of audio transcription. You benefit from a free tier on the first 1,000,000 tokens. You'll be charged from token number 1,000,001.

social_proof.title: Generative APIs | Scaleway
social_proof.text: Every new customer gets 1,000,000 free tokens—start paying only from the 1,000,001st token. Set up your credit card and pass the KYC process to benefit from the official rate limits.
